text:
elena: Heads up - Console shows doubled token counts when gateway transcodes REST -> gRPC. We need an attribution pattern for billing/quotas and for canary signals.

nate: Do we want to bill at the incoming route or split edge vs compute?

elena: PMs prefer incoming-route attribution. Infra wants compute visibility for chargebacks.

srini: Two practical modes: attribute-to-edge (single metric) or split (edge + compute). Either way we need a dedupe key so analytics don't sum both.

marta: UI suggestion: show merged by default, with a toggle to expand into edge vs compute columns. During rollouts allow "merged" to reduce noise.

nate: Implementation: gateway injects `x-rw-origin` + `x-rw-compute-units`. Backend increments compute counters. Gate header emission behind a feature flag.

srini: Security: headers must be signed for Dedicated customers to avoid spoofing. Also add a short trace id so dataflow can join spans and dedupe.

elena: Quotas: enforce at both layers. Edge enforces customer quota; backend enforces pool caps. Console should show which layer blocked a request.

ops-bot: Canary started: header-attribution v1 -> 5% traffic

marta: I'll mock the toggle UX and a small banner for rollout mode.

nate: I'll spike header signing and PR the envoy filter.

srini: I'll prototype a dedupe job in staging and test with sampled traces.

elena: OK good plan. Keep rollout small and ensure billing export mapping matches Console. Ping if blockers. :thumbsup:
